notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.2.2)
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the player's color selection in the settings could sometimes change unexpectedly.

- Fixed an issue in online play where, after reaching the goal in Sugoroku and while the reward screen was displayed, the close button on the results screen would become unresponsive after a forced exit due to being idle.

notes.title: Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) and Korean language support (Ver 1.2.0)

notes.title: Additional & Improved Features (Ver. 1.1.0)
notes.content:
- Added a offering box. (You can select it from the screen at the goal.)

- English has been corrected. （Thank you Will Bott for your cooperation)

- Overall load measures have been taken.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the inn signs to be dark when the video quality is set to low.

notes.title: Changes and Fixed (Ver 1.0.7)
notes.content:
- The maximum level of "JP Conversion" has been raised to 7.

- The time before auto-aim automatically resumes has been changed to 30 seconds.

- Made the sound of rain a little quieter.

- Fixed a problem in which the same room would be entered even if “Yes” was selected for the “Do you want to try to enter a different room than last time?” option when a quick match was selected.

- Corrected a typographical error.

notes.title: Improvements and Fixed (Ver. 1.0.4)
notes.content:
● Improvements

- The upper limit of the box expansion level was raised to 8.

- The volume setting range has been adjusted.

- The coins trail setting is now also reflected in "Gatling Coin".

- A sound effect has been added to indicate when "Gatling Coin" is ready for use.

- Added more details to the description of the auto-aim.


● Fixes

- Fixed a problem in which the store in the inn would not open if the menu was left open for a certain period of time while moving to the inn.

- Fixed a problem in which, under certain conditions, when the screen at the finish line is left displayed and the user is forced to leave, the next lap begins without earning a reward.

- Fixed an issue where the icon indicating that the user is away from the seat would sometimes not disappear.

- Corrected a typographical error.

notes.content:
- The message of the coin basket space and the palaquin space has been made easier to understand.

- Fixed an issue where buttons could not be pressed on the goal screen when playing with the gamepad.

- Reduced by one the number of dice replenished at the end of the event for multiplayer only.

- Fixed an issue where coins would not fly away when the wind blew if a monitor with a high refresh rate (120hz or higher) was used.
